name: ubl-invoice
label: UN/CEFACT UBL Invoice
description: EU e-invoicing standard — 27 EU countries mandate by 2028

table_notes.ubl_party: Represents any business entity (seller, buyer, or intermediary) identified by tax ID and address; shared by all invoices as supplier or customer.
table_notes.ubl_invoice: Header record for a single invoice document, linking supplier and customer parties, totals, currency, payment terms, and lifecycle status.
table_notes.ubl_invoice_line: One line item per invoiced good or service, carrying quantity, unit price, line total, UOM code, and tax category for that item.
table_notes.ubl_tax_total: Tax breakdown per invoice by category (e.g. VAT standard rate, reduced rate, exempt), supporting multiple tax subtotals per invoice as required by EN 16931.

ubl_party.name: id
ubl_party.description: Surrogate primary key; referenced by ubl_invoice.supplier_id and ubl_invoice.customer_id

ubl_party.name: party_id
ubl_party.description: Scheme-qualified business identifier (e.g. GLN, DUNS, or national company registry number)

ubl_party.name: party_name
ubl_party.description: Legal trading name of the party as it appears on the invoice

ubl_party.name: party_type
ubl_party.description: Role of this party record: 'supplier', 'customer', or 'tax_representative'

ubl_party.name: tax_id
ubl_party.description: VAT registration number or national tax identifier (e.g. DE123456789 for German VAT)

ubl_party.name: registration_name
ubl_party.description: Registered legal name (may differ from trading name used in party_name)

ubl_party.name: address_line
ubl_party.description: Street address lines, combined into a single text block for unstructured storage

ubl_party.name: city
ubl_party.description: City or locality of the party's registered or mailing address

ubl_party.name: postal_zone
ubl_party.description: Postal or ZIP code; format varies by country

ubl_party.name: country_code
ubl_party.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the party's address (e.g. DE, FR, GB)

ubl_party.name: electronic_mail
ubl_party.description: RFC 5321 email address for electronic invoice delivery or remittance notifications

ubl_party.name: telephone
ubl_party.description: Contact telephone number in ITU-T E.164 or local format

ubl_invoice.name: id
ubl_invoice.description: UUID primary key; referenced by ubl_invoice_line.invoice_id and ubl_tax_total.invoice_id

ubl_invoice.name: invoice_id
ubl_invoice.description: Seller-assigned invoice number; must be unique per supplier and used in payment references

ubl_invoice.name: issue_date
ubl_invoice.description: Date the invoice was issued; determines tax point and payment due calculation

ubl_invoice.name: due_date
ubl_invoice.description: Payment due date; NULL means immediate payment or governed by contract terms

ubl_invoice.name: invoice_type_code
ubl_invoice.description: UN/EDIFACT UNCL 1001 document type code: 380=Commercial invoice, 381=Credit note, 384=Corrected invoice

ubl_invoice.name: currency_code
ubl_invoice.description: ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this invoice (e.g. EUR, GBP, USD)

ubl_invoice.name: supplier_id
ubl_invoice.description: References ubl_party.id for the selling party (AccountingSupplierParty in UBL spec)

ubl_invoice.name: customer_id
ubl_invoice.description: References ubl_party.id for the buying party (AccountingCustomerParty in UBL spec)

ubl_invoice.name: payable_amount
ubl_invoice.description: Total amount due for payment, inclusive of tax and any allowances/charges

ubl_invoice.name: tax_amount
ubl_invoice.description: Total tax amount across all tax categories; must equal sum of ubl_tax_total.tax_amount

ubl_invoice.name: line_extension_amount
ubl_invoice.description: Sum of all invoice line amounts before tax (net invoice total)

ubl_invoice.name: payment_means_code
ubl_invoice.description: UN/EDIFACT UNCL 4461 payment means code: 30=Credit transfer, 49=Direct debit, 58=SEPA credit transfer

ubl_invoice.name: payment_id
ubl_invoice.description: Remittance reference or payment reference number the buyer must quote on the bank transfer

ubl_invoice.name: note
ubl_invoice.description: Free-text note on the invoice (e.g. delivery instructions, project reference, legal disclaimer)

ubl_invoice.name: status
ubl_invoice.description: Lifecycle state: DRAFT, ISSUED, SENT, ACCEPTED, REJECTED, PAID, CANCELLED

ubl_invoice.name: created_at
ubl_invoice.description: Timestamp when this invoice record was inserted into the database

ubl_invoice_line.name: id
ubl_invoice_line.description: Surrogate primary key for this invoice line row

ubl_invoice_line.name: invoice_id
ubl_invoice_line.description: References ubl_invoice.id; groups all lines belonging to the same invoice

ubl_invoice_line.name: line_id
ubl_invoice_line.description: Seller-assigned line number within the invoice (e.g. '1', '2'); used in buyer reconciliation

ubl_invoice_line.name: description
ubl_invoice_line.description: Free-text description of the good or service invoiced on this line

ubl_invoice_line.name: quantity
ubl_invoice_line.description: Quantity of goods or service units billed; up to 4 decimal places for fractional units

ubl_invoice_line.name: uom_code
ubl_invoice_line.description: UN/ECE Recommendation 20 unit of measure code (e.g. C62=piece, KGM=kilogram, HUR=hour)

ubl_invoice_line.name: unit_price
ubl_invoice_line.description: Net price per unit before tax and allowances; 4 decimal places for high-precision goods

ubl_invoice_line.name: line_amount
ubl_invoice_line.description: Net line total (quantity x unit_price minus line allowances); must match invoice line extension

ubl_invoice_line.name: item_classification
ubl_invoice_line.description: CPV, UNSPSC, or HS commodity classification code identifying the type of good or service

ubl_invoice_line.name: tax_category
ubl_invoice_line.description: UNCL 5305 tax category code: S=standard rate, Z=zero rated, E=exempt, AE=reverse charge

ubl_invoice_line.name: tax_rate
ubl_invoice_line.description: Applicable VAT or tax percentage rate for this line (e.g. 20.00 for 20% UK VAT)

ubl_tax_total.name: id
ubl_tax_total.description: Surrogate primary key for this tax subtotal row

ubl_tax_total.name: invoice_id
ubl_tax_total.description: References ubl_invoice.id; an invoice may have multiple tax subtotal rows by category

ubl_tax_total.name: tax_amount
ubl_tax_total.description: Tax amount for this category (taxable_amount x tax_rate / 100)

ubl_tax_total.name: tax_category_id
ubl_tax_total.description: UNCL 5305 tax category code: S=standard rate, Z=zero rated, E=exempt, AE=reverse charge

ubl_tax_total.name: taxable_amount
ubl_tax_total.description: Net base amount subject to tax at this category's rate

ubl_tax_total.name: tax_rate
ubl_tax_total.description: Tax percentage rate applied to taxable_amount for this subtotal row

ubl_tax_total.name: tax_name
ubl_tax_total.description: Human-readable tax scheme name (e.g. 'VAT', 'GST', 'Sales Tax') for display purposes

short_description: EU e-invoicing standard — 27 EU countries mandate by 2028
long_description: UN/CEFACT UBL (Universal Business Language) 2.1 is the OASIS standard for electronic business documents. The invoice schema covers the complete invoice data model including seller/buyer party details, invoice lines with UBL quantity/price, tax breakdown by category, and payment terms. Compliant with EN 16931 European invoice standard used in all EU e-invoicing mandates.
when_to_use: Use for any accounts payable/receivable system, ERP, or fintech platform operating in the EU. Italy (since 2019), Poland, Germany (2025), France (2026), and all 27 EU countries will mandate B2B e-invoicing by 2028. Also used in Australia (PEPPOL), Singapore, and many APAC countries. Essential for cross-border trade applications.
